ops.old: Flathead strips dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried crisp, in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, lime crema, sliced radish and coriander. Cut 600g flathead fillets into strips and toss in 2 tbsp flour, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with the zest and juice of a lime. Toss a quarter red cabbage, shredded, with lime juice and salt. Pan-fry the fish in hot oil for 2 minutes a side. Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, crema, sliced radish and coriander.
